notes.title: Major Demo Update & Kickstarter Launching Soon! (Please spread the word 🙏)
notes.content:
Hey Guardians! 🌸

While this update has been a long time coming, we have been busy like bees! 😇🐝 [b]We have some exciting news to share with you![/b]

[b]First of all: Thank you so much for all of your incredibly helpful feedback when playing the «The Guardian of Nature» demo [/b]🙏. We are so grateful that thousands of people have played the demo and that so many of you took the time to write down your thoughts, your play experience, what you liked and how we could improve the game. And we did! Many of you told us that there were these key things that you would like to see in the game:

✅[b] ✨ More story and background[/b] about The Guardians of Nature and the mission of Henry.
✅ [b]🧩 Hint system for puzzles[/b].
✅ 🗺️ An[b] in-game navigation[/b] to explore and visit all the environments.
✅ [b]🎛️ Quality of life improvements [/b]like more settings for sound and music.
✅[b] 🌸 More music tracks[/b] to change between environments.

[b]Introducing: The Book of Nature! 📔
[/b]
Many of the above points have been addressed by the creation of The Book of Nature, which tells the story of «The Guardian of Nature» through a beautiful fairytale-inspired narrative. Throughout the game, you will [b]regularly find and collect "Nature Cards"[/b], which unlock new pages in the book 📔. They tell you more about the ancient wisdom of the Guardians of Nature, the interconnectedness of nature, and give you hints on how to continue your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/c6ffcdd27045edb92c9b01799b647c027dd71a5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/adce3017204146c9f1183baf395072b3bbd52be8.png[/img]

Once you have accessed locations, they become accessible in The Book of Nature 📔. [b]A map helps you to navigate and understand how environments are connected 🗺️.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/10d3cb40c11d1df9f5011353c7f2cdb57567161b.png[/img]

In addition: We will be releasing a new and updated demo of the game very soon, alongside a [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inlusio/the-guardian-of-nature-game]Kickstarter campaign[/url] that we are currently preparing. [/b]

[b]It would mean the world to us if you would follow the Kickstarter campaign[/b] to be notified when it launches and tell your friends about it. Have a look here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inlusio/the-guardian-of-nature-game/


While early funding and our own resources will allow us to bring «The Guardian of Nature» to market, this Kickstarter campaign will allow us to realise the full vision of the game and share an exciting moment in the game’s journey together with you as a community!

Thank you for everything and take good care  🌱
Your fellow Guardians

notes.title: Demo update & «The Guardian of Nature» at Cozy Quest 2024!
notes.content:
Hey Guardians! 🌻

We are really excited to be a part of the upcoming Cozy Quest Festival on Steam from the 14th to the 18th of November 2024.

[b]Thank you so much for all the wonderful feedback we have received since we released the demo of «The Guardian of Nature» during the Tiny Teams Festival and the Wholesome Games Celebration back in August. We have been going through all your input and have updated the demo with bug fixes and Steam Deck compatibility (we are really excited about the last one and love to play and test the game anywhere!).[/b]

Thank you so much Secret Mode for organizing the Cozy Quest Festival! We look forward to seeing all the other wonderful games. Be sure to check out Cozy Quest here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SecretMode/sale/CozyQuest2024]Cozy Quest Steam Festival 2024[/url]

Please check out the demo and it would be wonderful if you sent us feedback via the form in the demo! 💚

Take care 🌱

notes.title: «The Guardian of Nature» is part of the Tiny Teams Festival by Yogscast Games!
notes.content:
Hey Guardians! 🌻

We have some wonderful news to share with you! We will be taking part in the 5th edition of the Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival, which showcases games from micro studios and solo developers. As a small team we are more than grateful for this opportunity. 

[b]The live stream of «The Guardian of Nature» will take place on Twitch and YouTube on Thursday, August 8th between 11am and 2pm BST and will showcase the latest state of our game with new environments, puzzles and many new forest animals 🦊 🐸 🐿️ 🪱[/b]

A massive shoutout to Yogscast Games for this wonderful initiative! Go check out all the other wonderful games on the Tiny Teams Festival Steam page!
[list]
[*][b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024]Tiny Teams 2024 Steam showcase page[/url]  [/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast]The Yogscast on Twitch[/url][/b] – streaming «The Guardian of Nature» on August 8th somewhere between 11am and 2pm BST
[*][b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@yogscast]The Yogscast on YouTube[/url] [/b] –  streaming «The Guardian of Nature» on August 8th somewhere between 11am and 2pm BST
[/list]
It would be absolutely wonderful if you could tell your friends and family about «The Guardian of Nature» and wishlist the game on Steam 💚

Take care 🌱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44209094/33c9eb252b81c7f2e5dce7767ffdb68803d89e69.png[/img]
